Meow! Hello, everyone! We're thrilled to share some exciting updates for Nyanco Impact with you!

[b]🌟 What's New:[/b]

[b]- 🚀 Launcher:[/b] The new launcher is now live!
[b]- 💬 AI Chat LLM:[/b] Introducing our beta AI Chat LLM Proxy—chat with your personalized AI character!
[b]- 🎨 Online AI Art Generator:[/b] You can create and share your own AI-generated art easily! Now in beta, accessible [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2889778383]here[/url].
[b]- 📤 Share Your Art:[/b] Easily share your creations on our [url=https://discord.gg/9QD6e7ea8p]Discord Server[/url].

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2889778383

[b](1) Improved Performance:[/b] Enjoy faster and higher-quality AI-generated images.

[b](2) Create Your Chatbot:[/b] Users can now design their AI chatbot characters, choosing roles, settings, and dialogues.

[b](3) Memory Feature:[/b] Your AI chatbot will remember past interactions for smoother conversations.

[b](4) Export/Import Functionality:[/b] Easily transfer your AI chatbot characters.

[b](5) Advanced Support:[/b] Nyanco LLM and reverse proxy are now supported.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33855818/ce71d6e4066bb403f5fa9d78539bea7709108d4e.png[/img]

Nyanco Impact features are generally free to users within our available scope. For usage and connection details, please see the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2889778383]Steam Community Guide[/url].

notes.content:
🚀 Launcher 💬 AI ChatGPT 🎨 Online AI Art Generator 🐾

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33855818/e934ed219ad2aa398c15b5f528c8a8d6fa5b1341.png[/img]

Meow! Hello, everyone! We have some exciting updates for Nyanco Impact that we would like to share with you!

🌟 Here's what's new : 

- 🚀 Nyanco Impact - Launcher Implemented
- 💬 Nyanco Impact - AI ChatGPT (Beta) Available
- 🎨 Nyanco Impact - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2889778383]Online (Beta) AI Art Generator[/url]
- 📤 Nyanco Impact - Easily Share Your AI Artworks on [url=https://discord.gg/9QD6e7ea8p]Discord Server[/url]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2889778383
🙌 Update Details : 

The primary focus of this update is to enhance the existing AI chat interface. Here are the details:

(1) Users can now create their own AI chatbot character and personalize various aspects such as character roles, settings, and messages.

(2) The AI chatbot character can now remember conversations with the user, resulting in smoother interactions.

(3) You can also export or import AI chatbot characters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106531/8b42039b970e266236b0e5a09c24caa8bc7e5fa3.png[/img]

🐾 Side Note : 

Previously, users had to activate the AI chatbot interface themselves using an OpenAI API Key or by connecting through a proxy server. However, we have some great news! To celebrate this new update, this feature is available for free for a limited time. (Please note that after the free trial period, users will need to obtain an OpenAI API Key or connect through a proxy server.)

Additionally, if you have activated the Nyanco Impact DLC, you can find the login credentials to access the AI Art Generator on the main screen of the game app. Your support, such as purchasing DLC or gifting it to your Steam Friends, would be immensely valuable to us!

Above all, we would like to express our gratitude for playing Nyanco Impact!（ฅ'ω'ฅ）

notes.title: 【News】 Nyanco Impact: Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106531/7d38c6721fed49a8d73376deca79cfe5963dbc35.png[/img]
🐾 Meow! Hey everyone, we have some exciting updates for Nyanco Impact that we want to share with you! 😻

🌟 Here's what's new : 
[list]
[*]📷The image database has been updated with fresh and exciting content.
[*]🐱A new Nyanco style has been added, adding even more variety to the game.
[*]🎉The Nyanco AI-Chat test version is now supported by Nyanco Impact Online!
[*]🚀We have made improvements to the UI, performance, and appearance of the Nyanco Impact Online test server, making your gaming experience even better.
[*]📤We've added a new function that allows users to send images they generate from the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2889778383]Nyanco Impact Online[/url] server to the [url=https://discord.gg/9QD6e7ea8p]Nyanco Discord server[/url], making it easier to share your creations with your friends.
[/list]https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2889778383
We are thrilled to announce that the Nyanco Impact Thumbs Up Edition is now available as a beta version. This edition features a collection of AI images of cat girl thumbs up poses. To access the beta version, follow these steps:
[olist]
[*]Locate the Nyanco Impact app in your Steam client.
[*]Right-click the app and click the 'Properties...' menu.
[*]Click on the 'BETAS' menu.
[*]Select '👍Thumbs Up Edition❤️' from the beta list.
[*]If the above procedure is completed normally, the app will be displayed as Nyanco Impact [beta] in the Steam client. To switch back to the original version, simply select 'None' from the beta list.
[/olist][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106531/b0b8fc6c7e0b23239508e0d5f9879facac9e4fa7.png[/img]

🙌 We are grateful for your support, and we want to remind you that the Nyanco Impact database now contains over [b]12,000[/b] AI images of cat girls, including DLC content. We hope you continue to have fun playing Nyanco Impact!🤖

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33855818/ce2da4e8bcd54cb5a11f78efc3ee970bf162299b.png[/img]

🎉 The AI chatbot test version using OpenAI API [ChatGPT] is now available in Nyanco Impact Online! Users who have activated the Nyanco Impact DLC can check the login credentials to experience the AI chatbot in Nyanco Impact Online on the main screen of the game app. If users respond well, we can add more features, TRPGs, and roles to the AI chatbot in future updates. 🤔 Considering the situation, we're still debating whether we'll continue to provide APIs or allow users to enter their own APIs to experience AI chatbots in Nyanco Impact Online. To be honest, since the OpenAI API is paid, we're not sure how long we'll be able to service it, but your support, such as purchasing DLC or gifting DLC to your Steam Friends, is very helpful to us! 🙏

Thank you for playing Nyanco Impact! (ฅ'ω'ฅ)

notes.title: Nyanco Desktop Mascot x Kagura Games
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33855818/08dce40bfdfc4bf1c6285ec3f2930a7d6aa6ebd3.png[/img]

Hello Everyone! (ฅ'ω'ฅ)

This Collaboration adds "Kagura-chan" to Nyanco Desktop Mascot

Kagura-chan is the mascot character of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Kagura]Kagura Games[/url]. Kagura Games is an American publishing company that specializes in the translation, localization, marketing, and distribution of Japanese video games into Native English. It started in 2018 and has since become one of the biggest publishers in the industry. If you are an anime doujin game fan, don't miss their projects!

To celebrate this collaboration, Kagura-chan will be featured in our app for the time being as the default mascot. However, at the end of this limited event's period, the default mascot will return to Nyanco. Afterwards though, users can still find Kagura-chan in this app's events folder and manually set her as the mascot of this app again.

Without your support, Nyanco Channel's contents such as reviews, videos, translations, and even our own games that we've developed would not have been possible so we would like to take this opportunity to express our thanks to our followers, partners, and you!

We hope you enjoy our collaboration event!ヽ(=´▽`=)ﾉ

Best Regards,
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/33855818-Nyanco-Channel/]Nyanco Channel[/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1522320/Nyanco_Desktop_Mascot/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39596969/9ea1398dc7334182a168ceb00c9e87b3fa30a499.gif[/img]

[b]How to set the collaboration content : [/b]
[list]
[*]Find images in the Event folder for the mascot character
[*]Steam Client -> Right-Click The App -> Properties -> Local Files -> Browse -> Event -> Kagura_Games_(Kagura-chan)
[*]Copy and paste them into the images folder
[*]Close the app and restart it
[/list]
